title: FaceTape
overview: A junkie decides to come clean from abusing an analog VR drug called FaceTape only to find his life outside of his addiction is far from stable.

title: Pinku Pastels
overview: An ordinary slice of life from young country students, Mew and Boat.

title: The Wronged of Juiced
overview: Gus sees a boy drinking juice. It is not the same as he remembers.

title: National Theatre at Home: Pride
overview: Summer 1984. The UK is in turmoil. With Thatcher battling to dismantle the coal industry, and a lethal pandemic on the rise, 24-year-old activist Mark Ashton founds an unlikely new alliance with the pit communities of South Wales: Lesbians and Gays Support the Miners. Funny, fierce and filled with joy, what follows is the incredible true story of two disparate communities joining forces – and making history. This brand-new musical unites Matthew Warchus and Stephen Beresford, director and writer of the hit film Pride, with composers Christopher Nightingale, Josh Cohen, and DJ Walde. Together they share the inspiring story of these real-life events, featuring original songs inspired by protest anthems, pop, rock, disco and the Welsh choral tradition.

title: Traços de Fuga
overview: Diana retreats into drawing and music to escape the chaos of her home. Each page of her notebook becomes an extension of the emotions she cannot bring herself to say out loud. But when even the smallest moments of peace are interrupted, Diana realizes that mentally escaping may no longer be enough to cope with the reality she lives in.

title: Sumpa Kingdom
overview: Raised in inland China, the protagonist Yangqing Lamu meets Baima, a young local guide, during an accidental trip to the plateau. The two travel deep into pastoral grasslands, embarking on a spiritual exploration of marriage, life and death, and morality amid the conflicts between dreams and reality, tradition and individuality. In the end, she achieves a profound reconciliation with both her homeland and her inner self in the vast wilderness.

title: Goodbye Eri The Fan Film Live Action
overview: Yago, following a personal request from his ailing mother, begins to document his life through recordings. This film project takes an unexpected turn when it becomes intertwined with a mysterious figure named Eri, exploring the fine line between reality and fiction whilst grappling with grief and artistic creation.

title: THE APE OF GOD
overview: A happening that connects perspectives of lost souls discovering a mysterious chain of voyeurism and obsession, that leads them to encounter the devil.

title: Chili Finger
overview: When a small town lawyer discovers a severed finger in her chili, she blackmails the restaurant for a cash payout in an effort to regain control over her mundane life. The situation quickly spirals out of control, and her life descends into chaos.

title: Under the City Lights
overview: The story of two friends, a boy and a girl, finding more about each other during their long walks around Rome.

title: National Theatre Live: Golden Boy
overview: Josh O’Connor (The Crown; Challengers) leads the cast in this searing revival of Clifford Odets’ knockout American classic.  1930s New York, at the height of the Depression. Joe Bonaparte is a gifted young violinist with a future in music, until a chance at fame and fortune lures him into the brutal world of professional boxing. He must confront what he’s willing to sacrifice, who he’s willing to become and how to find his place in a world that demands he choose a side.  Brought to life with a live string quartet and filmed live from the Almeida Theatre, Olivier Award-winner Sam Yates (Vanya) directs this propulsive drama exploring ambition, identity, and the high price of success.

title: Kathanar - The Wild Sorcerer
overview: Based on the tales of Kadamattathu Kathanar, the legendary priest who is believed to have lived in Kadamattom and possessed supernatural powers.

title: The Cat in the Hat
overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

title: 7G Rainbow Colony 2
overview: Nearly 10 years post the tragic death of Anitha, Kathir's ailing mother makes desperate attempts to get him settled after sensing his attraction to the daughter of Flat No.7G's Newest Tenant.

title: Queen of Mahjong
overview: Queen of Mahjong follows the hilarious and heartwarming stories of love, family, and hidden secrets in the Long family – Village Chief Long with his 3 daughters and 1 son. With three couples navigating love and laughter in their own unique ways, how will it all end?

title: Arasan
overview: Taking place as an untold story in the same world as Vetrimaaran's Vadachennai, a man holds a struggling, dark past in the 1990s.

title: Angel in White
overview: In early 2020, when the COVID-19 outbreak struck Wuhan, doctors Yuan Chuchu and Shen Yun joined forces with medical workers nationwide who answered the national call, rushing to the city to collaborate with local healthcare teams in tirelessly treating patients, ultimately containing the pandemic through the country's precise prevention measures and united efforts, composing a heroic anthem of this anti-virus battle.

title: Untitled Abbott Le-Eldred Film
overview: No details have been provided for this film yet.

title: Everest: The Other Side
overview: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

title: Kenan & Kel Meet Frankenstein
overview: Two delivery drivers' routine drop-off takes a terrifying turn when they arrive at a creepy, out-of-place castle and accidentally awaken Frankenstein’s monster — turning an ordinary night into a fight for survival

title: Shining in the Mountain
overview: A disappearance case quietly unfolds in the heart of the Loess Plateau. Various characters become entangled in a massive trap woven by money. Baiguo, stuck deep in the mire, is about to have her fate rewritten. As the truth comes to light, the shackles are broken, and all these characters rediscover the value of life and the true meaning of existence.

title: Embers
overview: Huang Yan, a terminally ill crematorium worker, accidentally mixed up two sets of ashes during her work. When she confessed the truth, neither family wanted to swap them back. Only Yao Xue, the daughter of one of the deceased, believed Huang Yan. The two embarked on a wild and absurd journey to return the ashes, where they came to understand life anew and chose to live bravely in the face of death.

title: In search of the Griffin
overview: It seems to me that the image of the griffin in my film represents something mythical, something ancient that once existed but which we have forgotten how to see and believe in. In this sense, the Griffin stands on the same level as the myth of Revolution and Love. And I would like to prove to everyone, just as I proved the existence of the Griffin in my dream, that true love and revolution—a change in the world order—are still possible despite the challenges ahead.

title: Family Memories
overview: Through a video call with their mother, family archival footage, and an on-camera makeup ritual, filmmaker ZIWEI 子维 explores kinship, inherited memories, and the construction of gender and identity.

title: The Wayans Bros. Reunion
overview: Join Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans, and Anna Maria Horsford for a fast‑paced and laugh‑filled night celebrating the sitcom that ran for five seasons and became one of the most memorable comedy series of the 90s. This special takes a look at the show’s origin and evolution through candid interviews with the cast and original directors, featuring classic clips, behind‑the‑scenes stories, and the brothers’ unfiltered commentary on how their unique comedic style shaped every episode. Packed with never‑before‑seen moments and genuine reflections, the reunion highlights everything fans loved about The Wayans Bros. while staying true to the show’s signature humor and energy.

title: Never Too Late
overview: Centers on a married couple in their 80s who decide to divorce, which proves shocking news to the small country-town community of Huaihua in Hunan province. Director Yang, who is their granddaughter, unpicks the story behind the separation and a marriage that began 60 years ago through matchmaking.

title: Uprising
overview: Through an AI-driven reinterpretation of Mexican Revolution footage captured by the country's cinema pioneers, this documentary offers a fresh look at a pivotal historical moment. It traces the movement's rise, peak, and fall, the birth of a new nation, and invites us to question the narratives that have shaped our identity and the present we inhabit.

title: For Better or Worse
overview: When they first met at Yuan Bo's secularization party, Li Xinran was still an actress suffering from depression. The two, both at the lowest point in their lives, fell in love at first sight and quickly came together, welcoming their first child. With several million yuan in savings, they envisioned an ideal life, but due to extravagance and a lack of financial management experience, they fell into an economic crisis. To turn their situation around, Yuan Bo planned to establish a handpan instrument factory in the mountains of Anji. The lush greenery seemed like their utopian dream. However, with the birth of their second child, their business failed, their business partner left, and they were burdened with debt. The daily grind and financial pressure gradually eroded their once passionate relationship. Deep in the mountains, they loved each other until they had nothing left but each other.

title: Probation
overview: After a life crisis, Li Xiang and a rookie lawyer set out to prove her good deed was right, reuniting with three high-school friends who help her seek the truth, heal old regrets, and warm a cold legal process with friendship.

title: Against The Clock
overview: Two brothers on the hunt. One man racing against time. Which one will get what they need first?

title: Echo of the Recess
overview: Xu Xiao, a Senior Two student from an impoverished family, always wears dust-streaked clothes. She suffers prolonged ostracism and vicious sneers led by classmate Zhou Qing and her gang. Her lunch tray is publicly knocked over, and she is subjected to humiliating torment in a rainy alley. Her only friend Su Meng keeps her distance, terrified of being implicated. When Xu Xiao seeks help from her head teacher, she only gets perfunctory, dismissive words. Her mother works nonstop to sustain the family, too swamped to detect the despair buried deep in her daughter’s heart. Abandoned by everyone, Xu Xiao has nowhere to seek solace.

title: sometimes, I... - The Breakdown
overview: A breakdown of every aspect of the production of the short film 'Sometimes, I...'

title: Deep Quiet Room
overview: After his pregnant wife Yi-ting unexpectedly committed suicide, Ming decides to take care of his father-in-law, only to find out the unbearable truth of Yi-ting’s family that leads to her death.

title: Разыскивается Дед Мороз
overview: On New Year's Eve, a not-so-lucky thief, Misha, breaks into a house in the very center of Moscow, where a lonely old man lives. Misha hopes to improve his unenviable financial situation and bring back his family - his wife and seven-year-old daughter. However, in the old man's big house, he finds nothing of any value, except for the deposits of children's toys in the basement. The old man himself assures him that he is none other than the real Father Frost.

title: Demigod: The Legend Begins
overview: The martial artist Su Hua-Jen has risked his life clambering to the summit of one of the five sacred mountains of Wu Lin, only to come across two monstrous beings in battle. His timely intervention turns the tide of the fight, and unbeknownst to him, sets in motion a series of monumentally consequential events. Back in the city, Su has a more mundane problem to face—an enormous debt with the local book lender. To pay this off, he must peddle his remarkable skills as a physician. While Su would prefer to steer clear of the affairs of the martial arts world, a request from the Lord of Globe Castle is financially promising—and might gain him access to the Fantastic Academy, where he can feast his eyes on the Limitless Celestial Book. But treachery is afoot, and Su is soon drawn into a crisis that will rock the foundations of Heaven and Earth.

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

title: Pretty Boy
overview: It's easy to be a pretty boy, but it's not easy to love one

title: The Hunger Games Series
overview: The Hunger Games is a dystopian science-fiction film series based on the novels by Suzanne Collins. Set in the ruined nation of Panem, the story follows young "tributes" forced to fight to the death in a televised arena. The saga follows heroine Katniss Everdeen as she sparks a national rebellion against the oppressive Capitol.

title: 万妖图录传之云州异客
Love Test
overview: A woman stages her own disappearance to test her boyfriend's love, only for him to quickly start a passionate relationship with another woman who unknowingly becomes entangled in the original scheme.

title: How To Become A Flight Attendant
overview: How To Become A Flight Attendant is a American biography which features American Actress Alana Spence and the rest of the cast from The First Class Cadet.

title: The Sparkle Switch
overview: "Get ready to sing, dance, and completely lose your mind! From the studio that brought you the massive theatrical smash hit comes The Sparkle Switch, a non-stop, high-octane musical ride that is taking over the world!

title: The Sound of Malan Flowers Blooming
overview: Adapted from a true story of the Beijing Winter Olympics, the film tells the touching story of the Malanhua Children’s Choir. With the help of An Ran, the performance management supervisor for the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, the Winter Olympics team, and Principal Liu from the mountain village primary school, the children overcame numerous hardships to leave their mountain home and step onto the stage of the Beijing Winter Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies, singing *Ode to the Olympic* in Greek. Meanwhile, the film reveals more little-known warm and inspiring stories behind the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, presenting a multi-faceted portrait of the Beijing Winter Olympics Spirit and the Olympic Spirit.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: 24 Flavors
overview: After years abroad, April returns to her homeland, discovering her divorced parents rekindling old ties. Memories of her extreme self-harm resurface as she grapples with her father's infidelity. Facing the impending demolition of the tea shop, April must decide between taking her mother Qiaozhen abroad or supporting her desire to continue the business. Struggling Yongtang silently raises funds for Qiaozhen's shop reopening, inadvertently falling into a scam. April also encounters her resilient half-sister Xiaojing. Amidst the challenges, she begins to reclaim the life, time, and self-reflection she had long avoided.

title: Plastic Guns
overview: A standoff reveals unsettling truths for an old cowboy.

title: Hexed
overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

title: Eureka or (The Quest for Nothing)
overview: A lonely surfer sets out to find the holy grail.

title: Kyle and Eric's Quest for the Golden Bong
overview: Two stoners go on an epic journey, filled with trials and challanges after finding a scroll that tells of a legendary lost artifact

title: Economy-Man: Black Friday
overview: Distraught with emotion after letting Mr. Knoflick destroy half the universe, Economy-Man sits at a crossroads, knowing he must stop Knoflick before the entire economy is destroyed but searching for a team who can help him beat this seemingly unassailable foe. Meanwhile, three other lost heroes lives intersect with his: Loggo, searching for his best friend, who thinks he is dead; Fry-Man, grieving after giving up the mask after the tragic death of his girlfriend, Gwel; and Bob the Soap, a once proud warrior who finds himself lonelier than ever. The four heroes, shrouded with loneliness, will band together to stop Knoflick from destroying the economy, but can they defeat him and his army before it's too late? The entire Economy-Man saga has led to this.

title: Lilo & Scratch
overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

title: CIRCA 1919: A Hollywood Murder
overview: On the production of the first western epic, a story-hungry journalist gets her break when a "prop gun" kills an actor.

title: We Live in Time
overview: An up-and-coming chef and a recent divorcée find their lives forever changed when a chance encounter brings them together, in a decade-spanning, deeply moving romance.

title: All Quiet at Sunrise
overview: Ma Ke immerses himself in his graduate dissertation on Lucy, the Australopithecus known as “grandmother of mankind”. After his mother inadvertently brings him to a remote house, he seems to discover a pathway to decode human language and regain the essence of love.

title: 7 Dogs
overview: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

title: A Song River
overview: To find the hometown in his memories, Zhu Xin tries to restore a Song Dynasty poem from a millennia ago, setting off a journey across time and space.
